family_name: Kingspan XPS Strip Slap Edge Insulation

spec.description:
Kingspan GreenGuard GG350 (XPS Strip Slab Edge Insulation) is a
high-performance rigid extruded polystyrene (XPS) insulation strip
purpose-engineered to insulate exposed concrete slab edges in residential and
commercial buildings. With a high compressive strength of 350 kPa and near-zero
water absorption, it stops thermal bridging at the perimeter of concrete
foundation slabs where up to 49% of ground heat loss occurs. Sized in
convenient 2400mm x 300mm x 40mm strips (R1.0), it delivers durable thermal
resistance to achieve 7-star NatHERS ratings without deteriorating from soil
contact or moisture.
features:
Purpose-designed XPS strip for insulating
concrete slab edges and foundation perimeters

High compressive strength
of 350 kPa (tested to AS 2498.3) resists heavy soil and backfill pressure

Fiber-free rigid extruded polystyrene core; non-deleterious and safe to
handle

Exceptional moisture resistance with water absorption less than 1% by
volume

Thermal conductivity of 0.028 W/m·K delivering R1.0 in a slim 40mm
profile

Eliminates thermal bridging at concrete slab edges to meet 7-star
NatHERS requirements

Pre-cut strip dimensions (2400mm x 300mm x 40mm) match
standard footing and slab depths

Unaffected by ground moisture, freeze-thaw
cycles, and soil microorganisms

Lightweight and easy to cut, shape, and
secure inside slab formwork before pouring

Zero ODP and low GWP manufacturing
process

install:
Position GreenGuard XPS strips vertically against the inside face of perimeter
slab formwork prior to pouring concrete

Ensure strips span the full depth of
the slab edge (typically 300mm height)

Butt strip ends tightly together and
seal joins with heavy-duty waterproof tape

Secure strips to formwork with
temporary double-sided tape or mechanical pins

Place damp-proof membrane
(DPM) under slab, turning it up behind the XPS strip

Pour concrete slab
directly against the XPS strip, ensuring full consolidation without dislodging
panels

Strip formwork after concrete curing; ensure exposed outer face of XPS
is protected by parging or flashing
selection_checklist:
Confirm
NCC 2022 slab-on-ground edge insulation mandate applies to climate zone
(mandatory in Climate Zones 7 & 8)

Measure total slab perimeter in lineal
meters to calculate pack requirement (12 lineal meters per pack)

Verify slab
depth (300mm standard strip width matches standard residential slab edge)

Ensure compatible render, parging coat, or flashing is specified to protect
above-ground XPS from UV
limitations:
Exposed above-ground XPS must be protected from UV sunlight
using a parge coat, render, or metal flashing

Must not come into direct
contact with solvent-based waterproofing, coal tar, or petrol

Insulating slab edges of

Kingspan XPS Strip Slab Edge Insulation (GreenGuard GG350) is
a 2400mm x 300mm x 40mm (R1.0) rigid extruded polystyrene strip purpose-designed
to insulate exposed concrete slab perimeters. With a high compressive strength
of 350 kPa (AS 2498.3) and near-zero water absorption (<1%), it halts thermal
bridging where up to 49% of ground heat loss occurs, satisfying mandatory NCC
